body.name: Uncalibrated LR profile sublevel sets
body.construction:
Let \(\widehat q_{n,\alpha}\) be any measurable \([0,\infty]\)-valued threshold. Define
\[
 \mathcal C_n(a)=\{t\in\mathbb R:Q_n(a,t)\le\widehat\kappa(a)\widehat q_{n,\alpha}\},\qquad a\in J.
\]
This definition supplies profile sublevel sets only; it assigns no nominal probability to the threshold.
